# Supplier Security Expectations

## Purpose

State high-level security and privacy expectations that may inform supplier
selection and contracting without publishing private contractual terms.

Suppliers handling material ORCHORDS information or providing important
services are expected, as appropriate to risk, to:

- maintain reasonable security governance and access control;
- protect credentials, secrets, and sensitive data;
- use secure development and vulnerability-management practices when supplying
  software or technical services;
- notify ORCHORDS of material security incidents according to applicable
  agreement requirements;
- manage subcontractor and supply-chain risk;
- support continuity, recovery, and exit needs proportionate to criticality;
- provide reasonable evidence of relevant controls when contractually required;
- avoid using ORCHORDS data outside agreed purposes;
- securely return or delete information at relationship end when required.

Specific obligations are defined by applicable agreements and risk decisions.
